chunks: And He (Glory be to Him) chose prophets from his offspring, taking from them a pledge regarding revelation and their trust regarding conveying the message, because most of His creation altered the covenant He had made with them, so they ignored His right, took equals for Him, the devils snatched them away from knowing Him, and severed them from worshipping Him,

So He sent His messengers to them, and despatched His prophets to them, to make them fulfill the pledge of His primordial nature, to remind them of the forgotten blessings of His grace, to establish the proof against them through preaching, to awaken for them the hidden treasures of intellects, and to show them the signs of Omnipotence:

namely the sky raised over them, the earth placed beneath them, means of sustenance that keep them alive, fixed terms that cause them to die, ailments that make them old, and events that succeed one another upon them.
ai.seo_question: How did Allah choose and send prophets to guide humanity according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this passage from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) elaborates on the divine selection of prophets from Adam's progeny, emphasizing their role in reviving the 'covenant of primordial nature' (mithaq fitrah) after humanity strayed from it. The text highlights the prophets' mission to remind people of forgotten blessings, establish divine proof through clear preaching, and awaken intellectual faculties by pointing to natural signs like the sky and earth. This reflects the Shia scholarly view of prophethood as a merciful restoration of the innate human connection to God, countering the influence of Shayatin who diverted people from true worship.

en.sayed-ali-raza: From his (Adam’s) progeny Allāh chose prophets and took their pledge for his revelation and for carrying His message as their trust.

In course of time many people perverted Allāh’s trust with them and ignored His position and took compeers along with Him. Satan turned them away from knowing Him and kept them aloof from His worship.

Then Allāh sent His Messengers and series of His prophets towards them to get them to fulfil the pledges of His creation, to recall to them His bounties, to exhort them by preaching, to unveil before them the hidden virtues of wisdom and show them the signs of His Omnipotence

namely the sky which is raised over them, the earth that is placed beneath them, means of living that sustain them, deaths that make them die, ailments that turn them old and incidents that successively betake them.
